regressions: Executable success cannot commit a semantically rejected repair.

A worker that reports blocked after semantic feedback remains rejected.
Independent-comparison conflict stays terminal and is not shown as a mandatory-pass target.
Separate review attempts cannot overwrite traces or reuse ledger operation identifiers.
code_quality: Ruff lint/format,ty and required pre-commit passed;see code-quality.json.
development_failures: A mistyped test filename collected no tests.
The synthetic ledger fixture initially reserved zero, which upstream correctly rejects; it now reserves a small fake amount and settles zero.
